2607.02879.title: MedCalc-Pro: Solving Complex Medical Calculations with LLM Agents
2607.02879.paper_summary: Current benchmarks for evaluating large language models (LLMs) in medical calculation are largely based on simplified settings, where each patient case corresponds to a single calculator and the required tool is explicitly specified in the query. However, real clinical scenarios often require multiple calculators for joint evaluation, nested-scale calculation, and fuzzy queries that do not directly specify the target calculator. To this end, we propose a new medical calculation benchmark, MedCalc-Pro, which covers three progressively challenging task settings: single-calculator, multi-calculator, and nested-calculator calculation settings. MedCalc-Pro contains 2,268 real-world clinical cases, covering 77 medical calculators across 14 clinical departments. Meanwhile, to address the limited performance of existing frameworks and methods in complex clinical scenarios, we further propose a more generalizable agent framework that supports multi-tool selection and nested-tool calling, while suppressing parameter error propagation through structured validation and evidence review. We conduct systematic comparisons across open-source, closed-source, and medical-specialized LLMs, and the results show that our framework achieves the best performance across all three task settings. This work provides a new benchmark and method for evaluating and applying LLMs in challenging medical calculation scenarios.
2607.02879.paper_summary_zh: 目前用於評估醫療計算的大型語言模型（LLMs）的基準主要基於簡化的設定，其中每個病人案例對應於一個單一的計算器，並且所需的工具在查詢中明確指定。<lb/>然而，真實的臨床場景通常需要多個計算器進行聯合評估、嵌套計算以及不直接指定目標計算器的模糊查詢。<lb/>為此，我們提出了一個新的醫療計算基準，MedCalc-Pro，涵蓋三種逐步挑戰的任務設定：單計算器、多計算器和嵌套計算器計算設定。<lb/>MedCalc-Pro 包含 2,268 個真實世界的臨床案例，涵蓋 14 個臨床科別中的 77 個醫療計算器。<lb/>同時，為了解決現有框架和方法在複雜臨床場景中的有限性能，我們進一步提出了一個更具通用性的代理框架，支持多工具選擇和嵌套工具調用，同時通過結構化驗證和證據審查來抑制參數錯誤的傳播。<lb/>我們對開源、閉源和醫療專用的 LLM 進行了系統比較，結果顯示我們的框架在所有三種任務設定中都達到了最佳性能。<lb/>這項工作為在具有挑戰性的醫療計算場景中評估和應用 LLM 提供了一個新的基準和方法。
